town_description: Wokha is the headquarters of Wokha district in central Nagaland, about 80 km north of Kohima, in Lotha Naga country. It is famous for the Doyang river valley, the seasonal roosting of Amur falcons at the Doyang reservoir from October to November, and views of Mount Tiyi. The town is a modest district administrative centre surrounded by hills.
